messages:
ana: quick UX pass on the condensed scorecard preview in prompt-sets. On mobile the preview collapses to an icon which is fine, but keyboard users can't expand it. Should be reachable via Enter/Space.

vik: agree. The icon needs tabindex=0 and role=button with aria-expanded. right now it's purely decorative.

sam: microcopy: tooltip currently says 'Preview'  ambiguous. Suggest 'Preview score impact' or 'Preview scoring change'. Shortest: 'Preview impact'.

toni: +1 for 'Preview impact'. Also we should avoid autosave when adjusting sliders in compact mode. Users were surprised that small weight tweaks immediately changed historical scores. Can we switch to Preview -> Save pattern?

ana: yes, Preview then Save. Preview updates client visual only, Save commits and creates a version with a message input. Toast appears: 'Weights saved as v3 — view changes' with audit link.

vik: accessibility nit: when Preview renders, we need an aria-live="polite" summary like 'Preview updated: new composite score X'. screen reader users need a quick summary.

sam: keyboard flow for preview panel: focus order should be: expand icon -> controls -> Preview button -> Save button -> close. Also allow Ctrl+P as a shortcut to trigger Preview when the panel has focus, but only if no text input is focused.

toni: shortcut caution: ensure we check isEditable(document.activeElement) before firing. Recent bug: Ctrl+P fired while typing in comment box.

accessbot: Accessibility audit: contrast for condensed score bars is 3.5:1 (fails AA). Recommend use token 'metric-700' or add 1px stroke for separation. Also ensure all interactive icons have 44x44 hit area per touch guidelines.

ana: noted. I'll update styles to metric-700 and pad hit targets.

vik: microcopy in Save modal: current title 'Save weights?' maybe better: 'Save scoring weights' body: 'Saving creates a new weight version and may affect historical runs. This action is logged.' primary 'Save weights' secondary 'Cancel'. Include count of affected runs if possible.

sam: when counts are expensive to compute, show 'May affect historical runs' and a link 'Show affected runs' that streams results. Also the Save button should be disabled while the backend computes the impact and show a spinner with label 'Computing impact...'.

toni: for the mobile condensed view, if Save is risky show an inline warning: 'Saving may change past scores — changes are versioned.' Provide 'Preview only' badge so users know it's not saved.

ana: final accessibility detail: when preview updates focus should not jump. Use aria-live for announcement only. And after Save, return focus to the Save button and move DOM to the version list anchor.

vik: tiny copy nit: toast after save should read 'Saved weights — version v3 created (undo)' and Undo should be keyboard-friendly. Undo reverts client-side and opens a revert modal.

sam: let's standardize min length for version message to 15 chars to avoid empty commit messages. Show helper 'Describe why you changed weights (min 15 chars)'.

accessbot: Reminder: modals require role="dialog", aria-modal="true", focus trap, and visible focus outline. Also ensure we announce when long-running compute finishes: aria-live="assertive" 'Impact computation complete'.

ana: perfect. i'll update figma frames and PR with these changes. dropping the updated copy and keyboard notes here once pushed. If anyone sees alternative wording for the preview tooltip, drop it before 3pm. :hourglass:
